newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Wah Nam Group shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Wah Nam Group shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Wah Nam Group Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Wednesday.
On Tuesday, Wah Nam shares fell HK$0.003 to HK$0.155.

Wah Nam Group is an investment holding company with subsidiaries engaged in the making of consumer electronic and electrical products, plastic and electrical goods, and ceramic tiles as well as property investment, construction and administration of infrastructure projects.
